visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in his 30s wearing a checkered shirt, sitting in the driver's seat of a stationary car. He has short dark hair and uses expressive hand gestures while looking slightly off-camera. The background shows an urban street with blurred traffic and buildings under bright daylight. A green banner with white text and a bear mascot is fixed at the top of the frame. (2) A satellite map of Iceland appears as an overlay, showing the white snow-covered regions and green coastal areas against a dark blue ocean. The view zooms out slightly to provide geographical context before transitioning to a comparative graphic showing Iceland's landmass outlined in orange next to Taiwan in blue. (3) A first-person view (POV) shot shows a long, straight asphalt road cutting through a vast, flat landscape with distant snow-capped mountains under a cloudy, overcast sky. No other vehicles are visible on the road, emphasizing the isolation of the rural Icelandic environment. (4) The camera returns to the man in the car. A cartoon graphic of a blue car with a distressed facial expression and a flying rock pops up over his shoulder to illustrate road hazards. Later, a photo of a small brown animal appears briefly to represent wildlife encounters. (5) Windy road footage is shown, with visible mist and rain blurring the windshield as the car moves forward on a wet surface. Tall streetlights line the side of the road. This is followed by a cartoon illustration of a car with a door bent backwards at a 180-degree angle due to strong gusts. (6) Images of an Icelandic cow with long brown fur and an Icelandic horse standing in a grassy field are shown sequentially to identify local hazards. A cartoon graphic of the car hitting an animal with a 'BOOM' cloud pops up. The video concludes with the man back in the car seat, while animated gold coins and bills rain down on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational warning for travelers planning to drive in Iceland, highlighting three specific risks that can lead to high out-of-pocket costs: gravel damage, wind damage to doors, and livestock collisions. It uses an energetic vlog style to grab attention while promoting the 'Taiwan Bar' and 'Da Zhua Zhou' platforms.
